type_note: operator-visible: one log line per start changes level and wording.
summary: Starting Nora no longer logs a warning for every Discord server she is not currently in voice on.
details: Boot asks each configured server's audio controller whether it already holds a connection to adopt. A server it holds none for now answers a distinct 'no connection' rather than a generic failure, and Nora records that as ordinary information instead of a warning.

On a cold start that is EVERY server, so the warning fired on every single start. A warning that always fires is one people stop reading, and then the start where adoption genuinely failed looks like the twenty before it. A refusal that is not 'no connection' still warns.
limitations: Behaviour is otherwise unchanged: nothing is adopted that was not adopted before, and every other caller treats the new case exactly as it treated the old one.
reason: Observed on the live deploy of the multi-guild change: `boot voice adoption for guild <id> failed: ... HTTP 404 (unknown_guild)` at WARNING on every start, because one controller process serving several guilds answers 404 for a guild it holds no connection for.
